headline: Trump asking advisers whether Defence Secretary Hegseth should stay after midterm losses
dek: CBS News, citing multiple sources familiar with the discussions, reported Wednesday that President Trump has been asking advisers whether Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth should remain in his post after Republicans' midterm losses, with some White House aides expecting part of the blame to fall on…
sources: CBS News (multiple anonymous sources) via Jerusalem Post; Al Jazeera liveblog White House reporting
fault_line: Scapegoat or accountability — did Hegseth and the generals mislead Trump with a 4–5-week war promise, or is Trump deflecting blame for a war he chose?
